summary: Alex Lee called for a ceasefire to protect children in Gaza in October 2023, amplified Ro Khanna's call for US recognition of Palestinian sovereignty in 2025, and endorsed Tom Steyer in 2026 because Steyer would 'stand against AIPAC.'
